spans.s: Going constantly or instigating everything (Sāy.) -ind. Here, in or to this place. -र्मः The arm; the fore-quarter of an animal; ईर्माभ्यामयनं जातम्

ईर्मान्त [īrmānta], a. Ved. Full-haunched, or thin-haunched. N. of a team of horses (of the sun's car); ईर्मान्तासः सिलिकमध्यमासः
